2026-11-05.patch_summary: This patch fixes a bug in the Btrfs file system where fallocate operations would update the inode's ctime and mtime even when FMODE_NOCMTIME is set, which prevents such updates. The patch introduces an 'update_times' flag that is passed from btrfs_fallocate() to its helpers, ensuring that these times are only updated when necessary. Additionally, it increments the inode's i_version unconditionally in btrfs_fallocate_update_isize(), as this operation can change the NFS change attribute even if the size extension stays within existing preallocation.
